csv_project_name: Design Service for Snowflake Lodge Facility Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Incline Village General Improvement District (IVGID or District) is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified architectural and engineering firms to provide 30% Design Services for the Snowflake Lodge Replacement Project (Project). The purpose of this procurement is to select a Design Team to advance the project from the completed Needs Assessment into a 30% Design package. The selected Design Team will be responsible for developing the architectural vision, site design, engineering concepts, cost estimates, and other deliverables necessary to establish the basis for future design development, and construction.
